services.name: Alchemy Exhibit
services.desc: This exhibit, curated by Alchemist Dennis Hauck, features a journey through the seven stages of the Alchemical process and a full-size reproduction of an Alchemist’s workshop. Join Dennis Hauck, PhD, Curator of the Alchemy Exhibit, as he guides you through this exhibit. The Alchemical Manuscript Series is a collection of rare, centuries-old alchemical material made available to English readers. It includes translations of important works by the eminent alchemists Basil Valentine, Anton Kirchweger, Isaac Hollandus, George Ripley, S.
